advice.roomRead: Roster 10: Holds both picks 90 and 91 back-to-back; already has RB Jeanty/Montgomery/Corum and TE Brock Bowers, listed need TE:medium, so they are far more likely to take a TE or WR than Price - but with two consecutive picks and an RB-heavy room tendency (41% RB share) they can comfortably take one RB flier, which is exactly the risk to Price. Roster 8: Picks at 93 immediately after our 92 with RB5 already rostered and needs WR/TE - they will not take Price but will compete for LaPorta/Kincaid at TE, which is why we want the RB now and the TE next.
